# Register lines lifted verbatim from "KP DJKA 116 TAHUN 2026 GAPEKA JAWA.pdf"
# (GAPEKA 2026), exactly as pdfplumber 0.11.4's extract_text() yields them and
# as data/gapeka/2026/pages.json caches them. Page numbers are 0-based, as the
# cache keys them. No test may open the PDF.
#
# tests/conftest.py drops comments and blank lines, and groups lines by their
# "# page N" marker. Each block is a few lines of its page, not the page, and
# keeps them in print order.

# their seconds.
